mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 4.5% triggers increased consumer spending and business investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in such periods do not exceed baseline returns (t-test p > 0.05) or IC < 0.03 over the period.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDP (demand) and federal funds rate (monetary policy) signals expansionary conditions, amplifying equity demand and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or returns are not significantly higher when both proxies increase.
